corrections.issue: Wrong speaker: the lines about AQR needing a good reason, April and May being cruel, and the SG Trend Index touching or exceeding its worst monthly drawdown are said by Richard Brennan (answering Niels's AQR remark), not by Niels Kaastrup-Larsen.
corrections.fix: Richard Brennan: trend followers are deep in drawdown in spring 2025, April was particularly cruel and May gave little respite, and the SG Trend Index just touched or slightly exceeded the worst monthly drawdown in its history.

corrections.issue: Mixed attribution: Niels only asks whether brokers charge the same per-contract fee for a nano as for a standard contract; the answer that fees are increasingly percentage-based and scaled to lot size is Richard Brennan's (and is stated as a general observation, not a guarantee that the problem is fixed).
corrections.fix: Niels Kaastrup-Larsen: a flat $5 each way on a nano costs far more relative to notional than on a standard contract at the same number of round turns. Richard Brennan: many venues now charge percentage fees scaled to lot size, similar to standard contracts.

completeness_estimate: 0.85 - the first reader caught all main trend-style, data-hygiene, small-capital and LLM-pitfall ideas; misses are secondary caveats (platform tooling, Panama engine/contango detail, LLM confident-wrong and prompt-design points, illustrative-path caveat).
